submission.justification: G3 gives the best simulated time resolution (0.846 ns at 1.75 mm, versus 1.276 ns for G1 and 1.9 ns for G2). However, GWP100 compliance (hard limit 150) could not be verified for any candidate because no GWP data was retrieved. This recommendation is therefore conditional: the GWP of G3 must be checked against candidate_specs.md before adoption. If G3 exceeds 150, fall back to G1 at 2 mm (1.276 ns), or to G2 if G1 also fails. The earlier recorded gap of 2 mm and the G2 resolution figure are not used, since G2 is the worst performer.
